answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, in each epoch, evaluate a committed identity polynomial with a Semaphore membership root as its anchor and an RLN rate-limit nullifier. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof and beacon challenge; a gale of duplicate messages reuses the nullifier, producing two polynomial shares that permit Shamir reconstruction of the signing private key. After verifying the opening, the protocol instantly slashes collateral, making each sybil identity economically prohibitive.
